No test emits a signal or changes the id, so removing retryHighlight() or the id comparison would pass. Add a fake signalApiRef to one case, emit a signal and assert getNotification is called a second time. If it stays cheap, also navigate from one id to another with the second fetch pending and assert the first item is gone. Change only this test file.
